correctness.rationale: Squared distance is (v-u)^2(1+(u+v)^2). No interior maximum is possible; the only noncorner boundary maximum solves 2w^2-2aw+1=0. On this branch the square-distance tie is exactly w^4-w^2-1=0 and gives the unique golden-ratio threshold. Positive local derivatives A=2 sqrt(1+w^2), B=(2w^2-1)/(2w sqrt(1+w^2)) yield the linear-quadratic tail-area constant; the endpoint has independent linear defects. Uniform parameter density on the ordered triangle is 1/(2a^2). Standard localization and dominated convergence establish both probability limits and total-variation conditional limits. Fixed-parameter numerical integration supports the coefficients without replacing the proof.
